properties.purpose: Utilitly/Support view to show SAP material-plant entries for production plants without an entry in tlgnc_mat_plant. Since LOGON 1.4.0 an entry in tlgnc_mat_plant is mandatory for all material-prod-plant (because of NORM_DESC, BRAND_SALES_NAME). If missing: material cannot be used by LOGON. View is not used by the application itself.
